name: Gypsy Restaurant
why_it_matters: Founded 1991 by Umesh Chandani in Sardarpura — Jodhpur's most-cited unlimited pure-veg thali. 33 items rotated seasonally: gatte ki sabzi, ker sangri, kadhi, dal, three rotis (bajra, missi, tandoori), pickles, sweets. Unlimited refills are house policy.
insider_tip: Lunch (12-3pm) is faster service than dinner. Pace yourself — refills come unasked, and the dessert course (ghevar/gulab jamun/kheer) is a separate plate after the thali is cleared.

name: Hanwant Mahal Rooftop
signature_dish: Marwari laal maas with Umaid Bhawan view
why_it_matters: Open rooftop with one of Jodhpur's clearest views of Umaid Bhawan and Mehrangarh from a non-hotel address. Rajasthani folk dancers most evenings; the standalone alternative to the heritage-hotel circuit at half the price.
insider_tip: Sunset view is the reason to come — book a 6:30pm slot to catch the fort floodlights at 7pm. Lift available; rooftop is on the 4th floor.
signature_address: Circuit House Road, near Lalji Handicraft, Ratanada, Jodhpur 342001
